provenance.failure_reason: TlsChainBroken: https://pmajay.dosje.gov.in TLS chain could not be verified (incomplete chain served by the portal; OpenSSL does not chase AIA). Underlying error: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1010)
provenance.fallback_note: pmajay.dosje.gov.in was unavailable, so the GIA catalogue could not be fetched. Emitted 1135 structurally identical rows whose QP code, job-role name, sector and NSQF level are REAL values from the NCVET Kaushalverse register (pipeline 02, live). What is synthetic is the catalogue membership itself — i.e. the claim that PM-AJAY's GIA catalogue lists this QP — plus the Course/Sub-Course grouping. Every row carries synthetic=true and source='kaushalverse'; the flag is preserved into the database and rendered in the dashboard. For scale reference research.md 3.4 measured the real catalogue at ~2360 rows / ~1893 unique QP codes.
notes: QP identities are real (NCVET Kaushalverse); catalogue membership is synthetic.
2026-09-11: GET /course-list and GET /illustrative-list both return HTTP 200 but serve resources/views/maintenance.blade.php ('We'll be right back') — the portal is under maintenance.

2026-09-11: POST /front/reportajax returns HTTP 500 with a Laravel ErrorException naming app/Http/Controllers/front/UserController.php, i.e. the debug-mode leak research.md 3.4 warned about, now firing because the app files are absent.

2026-09-11: the host serves an INCOMPLETE TLS chain, so OpenSSL clients (every Linux container) fail with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED while Windows clients succeed via AIA fetching. Reproduce the maintenance finding from a container with PMAJAY_INSECURE_TLS=true.

Static assets on the same host DO still serve — the May-2023 guidelines PDF downloads normally and is byte-identical (1,506,893 bytes) to the socialjustice.gov.in mirror, which is why pipeline 06 still builds a real RAG corpus.
1135/1135 rows carry a register-assigned NSQF level
0 rows fell back to an hours-derived band and are flagged level_inferred=true
263/1135 levelled rows sit at a half level (23.2%)

CAVEAT: the course catalogue itself came from pipeline 01's fallback, which derives course rows FROM this Kaushalverse register. The match rate above is therefore tautological and is NOT evidence that the real PM-AJAY catalogue joins cleanly to NCVET. research.md 5.1 expects imperfect coverage against the live portal; the hours-derived level fallback stays implemented and tested for that case.
